title: Quire capture skill config
description: User preferences for how the quire-capture skill routes and confirms notes. Lives at ~/.config/quire-mcp/skill-config.json.

onboarded.description: True once first-run onboarding has completed.

organizationModel.description: topics = folders within a notebook; files = different notebooks by subject; flat = one notebook, tags only.

defaultFile.description: Configured MCP file name to capture into by default.

topics.description: The user's main topics/areas (seed folder names).

confirmation.description: always = confirm every save; ambiguous = confirm only when routing is unclear; silent = save and report.

sections.description: Ordered section headings for the digest leaf.

lastDigestAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last digest run, or null.
